chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Faces a Perfect Copy in a Bloody Identity Crisis – Chapter 339
chapter_meta_description: Cornered by enemies, Li Huowang is thrown into chaos when a perfect Zuowandao copy of himself appears. Is the only way out to make everyone doubt everyone?
og_title: Who Is the Real Li Huowang? A Masterclass in Trickery
og_description: In this brutal chapter, trust is a liability. Li Huowang's only escape might be the very lie that seeks to replace him.
twitter_title: Fighting a copy of yourself has never been this messy.
twitter_description: Li Huowang faces a perfect double and has to use his enemies' own suspicion to survive. Chaos is the only weapon.

lore_anchors.definition: A form of black magic where venomous creatures are sealed together until the sole survivor becomes a supernatural poison parasite. Tuoba Danqing is a Gu cultivator.
A protective pendant given to children to 'lock' their life force and ward off evil. A dark irony when worn by a killer.
A secret society of liars who pervert the Daoist concept of 'sitting in forgetfulness.' They weaponize deception and identity theft.
Li Huowang's parasitic 'daughter,' a sentient Black Tai Sui entity that emerges from his body as a black tentacle to aid him in combat.
A ritual Daoist weapon made of coins strung on red cord, used by Li Huowang and Li Sui.
A powerful and sharp sword of the 'military path' that corrupts its user with aggression. Li Huowang wields it here.
A classical xianxia technique allowing the user to swim through the earth. Here, it is an accusation rather than a real ability used.
A powerful, large monk who acts as an enforcer for Tuoba Danqing's group.
